Spotube V6 is here 🎉🚀
🔥Highlights
• Migration from Flutter to Compose Multiplatform, learn why we did it
• UI redesign, introducing Millennium UI. 2000s look and feel with 2026's modernity
• Jam sessions, play music with friends and family in sync. Runs on a new dedicated room server, with host-only controls and device bans to keep rooms safe
• Full Android Auto integration. Browse, Library, Search all are there now, not just queue
• iOS now plays audio through VLC, so every streaming format works, and keeps playing in the background
• Migration from hetu_script to Kotlin for plugin development. Powered by Zipline by Cashapp
• More extensibility, plugin support for Lyrics provider and Scrobbling providers
• Redesigned plugin manager. Plugin login pages can only reach cookies and scripts of the domains they declare
• Native Android APK, with reduced apk size, performance improvements and more native android integrations.
• Relicensed from BSD-4-Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later for a more Open Source friendly licensing. And for preventing distribution of closed source and maliciously modified Spotube.
💫 Features
• Migration to Compose Multiplatform
• Add ChipTab component and refactor SearchScreen to use it
• Add AutocompleteTextField component and integrate it into SearchScreen
• Enhance AutocompleteTextField with focus management and dropdown behavior
• Enhance AppSidebar with improved button interactions and visual feedback

New
• Library sync: pair your phone with the Desktop app once by QR, and likes, followed artists, saved albums and podcasts, playlists and listening history stay the same on both, over your own Wi-Fi or Tailscale
• SoundCloud Now Playing style: artwork on a card, the song's waveform as the seek bar, comments shown at their moment, and a comment box with quick reactions
• 8D audio on Android and Desktop: the song moves around your head, with the direction and the time per turn of your choice
• Import sign-ins from a browser on Desktop: take your YouTube or Spotify sign-in from a browser on the same computer instead of pasting cookies
• Word-by-word lyrics from LRCLIB when it has word timing for the song
• Music app colours: Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music and YouTube Music presets in the app colour picker
Improved
• AutoMix: a fade ends where the last chorus ends, and the next song comes in at the end of its intro
• Downloads: Remove download and Cancel download in the song menu, and remove several at once from the Downloaded list
• Discord login on the Full build: on Discord's own page in your browser, with no account token read by the app (log in again once)
• Desktop: vertical scrollbars on every scrolling page, the sidebar, the queues and the comments, and artist logos that scale with the page
• Home on Android fits more on screen, and rounded…
